# Executable examples

These files are used by the client guides and checked by `tests/examples`.
The [local CLI example](local_app/README.md) runs from a consuming application
using the installed package. Other modules run after their documented setup.

For one connected walkthrough, start with the [market tutorial](tutorial/README.md).

| Asset | What it demonstrates | Required environment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Local application](local_app/README.md) | Setup, API/Admin launch, explicit bootstrap, application-owned migrations and persistent write/read | Installed package, application Git checkout, SDK login; Node/npm for Admin. |
| [tables.py](tables.py) | Related account and time-index balance contracts | Import/contract checks are offline. |
| [quickstart.py](quickstart.py) | Retrieve and validate a visible table | Configured API, SDK session, table grant. |
| [external_table.py](external_table.py) | Register an existing physical relation | API, source access, pre-existing matching table. |
| [query.py](query.py) | Compile parameters for the runtime DataSource | Supply DataSource and dialect for offline compilation; execution needs API access and table grants. |
| [updater.py](updater.py) | Incremental deterministic sample observations | Frame checks are offline; full run needs migrated/bound models and an existing account. |
| [reader.py](reader.py) | Read output without a producer | API and visible time-index table. |
| [DataSource registrations](data_sources/README.md) | PostgreSQL, MySQL and MSSQL connection management | Configured API; validation also requires API-side drivers, Secret access and a reachable database. |

```bash
python -m pytest -q tests/examples
python -m metatables.examples.quickstart TABLE_UID
```

The [managed-table guide](../client/define-and-migrate-tables.md) explains how
to place models in your application's provider and generate revisions. Example
tests distinguish pure/local checks from isolated API transport checks and live
physical database checks; they do not claim hosted deployment verification.

## Bounded consumption

[bounded_reader.py](bounded_reader.py) processes an existing time-index output page by page. It uses only the installed library and Main Sequence API. See the [transfer guide](../client/bounded-transfers.md) for budgets and receipt recovery.
